title: Combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials

result.label: Combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials
result.statement: Resolves the full combinatorial invariance conjecture: isomorphic Bruhat intervals in arbitrary Coxeter systems have identical equal-parameter Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials. Thus the abstract order of the interval determines the polynomial, even across different Coxeter systems.
